peers.name: R M DRIP & SPRINK SYS LTD

bull_bear.body:
- 2026 milestone: 'Credit rating upgraded to BBB / A3+ and paid-up capital increased to ₹12.04 Cr'.
- Balance-sheet ratios shown for FY24/FY25/FY26: Debt to Equity 1.07 / 0.45 / 0.47 (In Times); Interest Coverage 2.99 / 3.29 / 6.04 (In Times); Current Ratio 1.59 / 2.14 / 2.14; Net Worth ₹95.45 Cr / ₹149.36 Cr / ₹191.43 Cr.
- Working capital is the visible strain: Trade Receivables ₹241.05 Cr (FY26) vs ₹185.92 Cr (FY25) and ₹176.61 Cr (FY24), against Cash & Bank Balance of ₹0.94 Cr in FY26; Cashflow from Operations was -22.39 (FY26), 7.83 (FY25) and -13.69 (FY24) in ₹ Cr, with Cashflow from Financing of 29.36 (FY26).
- The company's own stated remedy is mix-led rather than balance-sheet-led: raise the share of commercial (non-subsidy) sales, PVC pipes and exports 'to reduce working capital'.
- The deck makes no mention of dividends, buybacks or a stated payout policy.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- Established in 1997 with '27+ years of industry experience'; engaged in manufacturing and exporting micro irrigation solutions, with a 'Strong distribution network across 16 states in India' and 'Export presence across Africa, Latin America and Middle East'.
- Three business segments are named: Micro Irrigation Systems, Solar EPC Services and Polymer Marketing (IOCL); the deck describes a 'Strategic partnership with IOCL for polymer product marketing in Gujarat' and lists as a core strength being "IOCL's channel partner for polymer products in Gujarat".
- Key Facts slide cites 750 dealers, 325 team members, 3 manufacturing units and 16 states of domestic presence.
- Solar EPC franchise is being built on repeat MSEDCL wins under PM-KUSUM: the deck counts '5 Order Wins Repeat Orders from MSEDCL', '3,000 Total Solar Pumps' and '₹77.23 Cr Total Order Value', and frames these as reflecting 'Execution Capability, Customer Confidence, And Strengthening Presence Under The PM-KUSUM Programme'.
- Dripline technology is sourced from Israel (flat drip lines, from 2012) and the United States (round drip lines, from 2011); the plants slide says they are 'Equipped with state-of-the-art machinery and Dripline technology from Israel and the USA for high-quality production.'
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Listing] 2026 milestone records 'NSE listing effective 23 July 2026'; the company IPO'd on the BSE SME platform in 2013 and 'Transitioned to the BSE main board' in 2016.
- [Order book] MSEDCL PM-KUSUM order journey as listed: Aug'25 Letter of Empanelment ₹5.97 Cr / 200 pumps; Nov'25 first order ₹8.17 Cr / 300 pumps; Dec'25 first order ₹27.69 Cr / 1,000 pumps; May'26 repeat order ₹11.80 Cr / 500 pumps; Jul'26 latest order ₹23.60 Cr / 1,000 pumps. The 2025 milestone slide separately states 'Secured ₹ 41.83 Cr MSEDCL order for 1500 off-grid solar pumps'.
- [New customer] 2026 milestone: 'Received LOA from DGVCL under PM-KUSUM Scheme for supply of off grid solar pumps in Gujarat.'
- [Shareholding] As on 30-06-2026: Promoter & Promoter Group 68.79%, Public 31.21%. Stock data as on 07-08-2026: Share Price ₹71.94, Market Capitalization ₹432.93 Cr, 6,01,78,790 shares outstanding, Face Value ₹2, 52 Week High-Low ₹87.75 - 52.67.
- [Promoter family management] All three named executives are Khichadias - Ramesh (Chairman & MD, B.Tech Agriculture Engineering, 30+ years in pipes and irrigation), Gopal (Director, 25+ years) and Ritesh (Whole-Time Director, IIT Bombay / IIM Lucknow, ex-Sanford Bernstein and Ernst & Young).
business.title: Notable from the deck

deepdive.thesis: The deck positions Captain Polyplast as an 'Integrated Irrigation & Renewable Energy Solutions Provider' - a 1997-vintage micro-irrigation manufacturer and exporter with three plants that has diversified into Solar EPC (solar water pumping and rooftop) and IOCL polymer marketing in Gujarat.
